tokens.name: label

tokens.name: label-secondary

tokens.name: control-stroke

tokens.name: accent

tokens.name: accent-fill

tokens.name: on-accent

tokens.name: destructive-fill

tokens.name: focus-ring

tokens.name: selection-fill

tokens.name: menu-highlight
tokens.usage: 菜单项悬停高亮，文字切换为 `on-accent`（≥ 4.7:1）。比 systemBlue 略深，保证白字可读。

tokens.name: glass-fill

tokens.name: glass-edge
